nodes.label: UiQuad.frag
nodes.rationale: Flat-color UI fragment shader driven entirely by a push constant, so a quad's color can change without touching a descriptor set.

nodes.label: Push-constant flat color for UI quads
nodes.rationale: Each quad's color arrives as a push constant rather than a descriptor set, so many differently-colored rects can be drawn from one pipeline with no per-quad descriptor churn.
